  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",

  "task_id": "LEV-CH01-ONE-STEP-METHOD-DEFINITION-PRODUCTION-20260908",
  "source_sha256": "b3adec0d3616dbde57a5522cfce1861890887d7c03a2232d2136cb94c9bac1d5",
  "dossier_sha256": "8e4c808d84cccdc3610f6e5dbc0487d63d4caf17e09eb72535dbdaad1a171011",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "NumStability.leveque01IsOneStepMethodAt",
      "interpretation": "For every pair of histories of length n+1, equality of their final states implies equality of their advance outputs.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the left side as independence from earlier history, relative to the full current spatial state.",
      "source_match": "Captures the temporal dependence condition on page 10, provided the represented spatial state includes all relevant current-time data. The source does not establish that identification or the unrestricted history domain.",
      "status": "unclear"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "Eq",
      "reuse_sha256": "39e5d712f8b9aad981a3e0033fb34773c91d2d18aa78ceae215fff254098f57c",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires exact equality of advance with the composite function, hence agreement on every represented history.",
      "source_match": "Exact determination, rather than approximate agreement of outputs, matches the selected characterization.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "Exists",
      "reuse_sha256": "6359bd4891661a259e43b293071b870dfaf8d2663a00ef2b860ca97590591ec3",
      "effect_on_target": "Introduces a current-state map separately for each n and advance.",
      "source_match": "Expresses determination by a function without requiring an explicitly computable formula. Its total domain inherits the unresolved state-domain modeling choice.",
      "status": "unclear"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "Fin",
      "reuse_sha256": "42f7e9d2dc9ef433c72f636953d97095440cad97655560bc45332db987086dc7",
      "effect_on_target": "Indexes history entries from 0 through n and vector components from 0 through m-1.",
      "source_match": "Finite component indexing represents the m-vectors on page 11 by harmless reindexing; history indexing makes the current entry available.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "Fin.last",
      "interpretation": "Returns the element with natural-number value n in Fin (n+1).",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects the current state at index n from each history.",
      "source_match": "Matches the current level t_n, with the output interpreted as the next level.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "Function.comp",
      "interpretation": "Composes functions by applying the second function to the input and then the first function to that result.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the right side evaluate as step (history (Fin.last n)).",
      "source_match": "Preserves the direction from current data to next output and excludes access by step to earlier history.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "reuse_sha256": "53176a5fdb3ab4aa2f268a561a58a549dc054913e8becee255de6c912d398329",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses natural-number addition to form the history length n+1.",
      "source_match": "Includes the current index n without introducing a numerical time-step size.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "Iff",
      "reuse_sha256": "9e39ec4853ddf029e9f8baacdc334db243e376c5cff18854e467480afbace6dd",
      "effect_on_target": "Equates history independence with representation by a current-state map.",
      "source_match": "This is a valid mathematical characterization of determination within the supplied model; applicability of that model to the complete source characterization remains unresolved.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "Nat",
      "reuse_sha256": "8ff28ee246e10f28be0ab7a8e23423d7b51e962a547cf5fe9c3cea6ce359a162",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows nonnegative time indices and component counts, including zero.",
      "source_match": "Natural time indexing is consistent with successive numerical levels. Zero components add a harmless degenerate case to the characterization.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "reuse_sha256": "f5569c7fe350971b4ea22c6995e80aebbff91bc37ff5dc40b33406c739e1a489",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the literal 1 in n+1 as a natural number.",
      "source_match": "Correctly supplies the extra history slot for index n.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Real",
      "reuse_sha256": "0d347da13527e70df7c0618f099de0a3ba95c1b1982bbae9852c91d1c5a57d2d",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes every state a spatial field of real m-vectors.",
      "source_match": "Consistent with the numerical solution notation and vector context, but that field is not explicitly identified with all current-time data in the selected passage.",
      "status": "unclear"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "instAddNat",
      "interpretation": "Supplies Nat.add as the addition operation on natural numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures n+1 is ordinary natural addition.",
      "source_match": "The history indexing uses the intended successor count.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "reuse_sha256": "960f87c7c53933b2acf4803d94f9778313cfbc9ad9db91e0fb8010d571f48495",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects overloaded addition to instAddNat.",
      "source_match": "Introduces no altered arithmetic or extra numerical assumptions.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "instOfNatNat",
      "interpretation": "Assigns each natural-number literal its own natural-number value.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the history-length increment exactly one.",
      "source_match": "Consistent with indexing the levels 0 through n.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "Function.FactorsThrough",
      "interpretation": "For functions g and f with common domain, requires that f a = f b implies g a = g b for every pair a,b.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires advance to be constant on fibers of the current-state projection, over all histories in its domain.",
      "source_match": "Expresses the intended independence from earlier-time data within the modeled domain. Whether all arbitrary histories and only the Q field are the intended domain and data is not settled by the source.",
      "status": "unclear"
    }
  ],
  "semantic_checklist": [
    {
      "id": "C01",
      "status": "pass",
      "source_evidence": "The attached rendering of raw page 32, printed page 10, contains the selected sentence in Section 1.7. Page 33 continues with the m-vector convention; page 31 concerns software and references.",
      "lean_evidence": "The proof-free header and both elaborated types describe the supplied one-step characterization.",
      "reasoning": "The selected passage and relevant immediate context were inspected directly in the attached images. Source and dossier hashes are supplied identifiers, not independently recomputed hashes."
    },
    {
      "id": "C02",
      "status": "unclear",
      "source_evidence": "Page 10 distinguishes spatially indexed numerical approximations Q from q and refers to current-time data without enumerating their contents; page 11 permits m-vectors.",
      "lean_evidence": "The state is exactly Cell → Fin m → Real, and advance accepts every Fin (n+1)-indexed history of such states.",
      "reasoning": "Arbitrary Cell accommodates spatial grids and all components are retained. However, identification of this state with all current data and the unrestricted input domain needs justification."
    },
    {
      "id": "C03",
      "status": "pass",
      "source_evidence": "The source discusses a generic transition from t_n to t_{n+1} without requiring a uniform time-independent operator.",
      "lean_evidence": "The existential step occurs inside the universal binders for n and advance.",
      "reasoning": "The witness may depend on the time index and the chosen advance; it is shared across histories only for that fixed transition. No autonomous-method assumption is introduced."
    },
    {
      "id": "C04",
      "status": "unclear",
      "source_evidence": "The source gives no admissible-state domain or totality assertion.",
      "lean_evidence": "The binder advance is a total function on the full history type, and D015 quantifies over every history pair.",
      "reasoning": "Totality is built into the input type rather than proved. For a characterization intended to cover admissible-domain methods, this could reduce applicability; the passage does not resolve the intended scope."
    },
    {
      "id": "C05",
      "status": "unclear",
      "source_evidence": "The substantive content is complete determination of the next solution by current-time data.",
      "lean_evidence": "The right side represents advance solely through the full current Q field.",
      "reasoning": "The temporal dependence content is complete within the state model. Completeness relative to the source depends on whether auxiliary current data require representation."
    },
    {
      "id": "C06",
      "status": "pass",
      "source_evidence": "The passage supplies a prose dependence characterization and no numerical update formula.",
      "lean_evidence": "D001 expands to D015; D015 is fiberwise constancy. D005 selects index n, and D006 composes the selector with step. Arithmetic instances use ordinary natural addition.",
      "reasoning": "All fifteen dependencies have been accounted for using their bodies or exact supplied reuse records. No meaning was inferred solely from a declaration name."
    },
    {
      "id": "C07",
      "status": "pass",
      "source_evidence": "The source characterizes a one-step method by determination entirely from the current level.",
      "lean_evidence": "The proposition equates fiberwise constancy with exact factorization through the current-state projection.",
      "reasoning": "For the specified domain these are equivalent: define step(s) using advance on the constant history s; conversely, equal current states give equal composite outputs. This is exact dependence, not an accuracy estimate."
    },
    {
      "id": "C08",
      "status": "unclear",
      "source_evidence": "Q is a numerical approximation, while the phrase current-time data is not explicitly equated with Q alone.",
      "lean_evidence": "Both history entries and outputs have the same spatial vector-field type; there is no separate auxiliary-data object.",
      "reasoning": "Current and next numerical states remain distinct, and q is not conflated with a computed field. The possible identification of all data with Q remains unresolved."
    },
    {
      "id": "C09",
      "status": "pass",
      "source_evidence": "The source transition uses current index n and next index n+1; components on page 11 are numbered 1 through m.",
      "lean_evidence": "Fin.last n selects n from a length-n+1 history. Components use Fin m; step is chosen for each n.",
      "reasoning": "There is no off-by-one error. Component numbering is a harmless reindexing, and the output serves as the next state without imposing any fixed physical time increment."
    },
    {
      "id": "C10",
      "status": "unclear",
      "source_evidence": "The characterization does not specify a state-space type, admissible histories, or restrictions on current data.",
      "lean_evidence": "The theorem specializes the abstract dependence property to total advances on unrestricted histories of real vector fields, while allowing arbitrary Cell and zero components.",
      "reasoning": "The spatial generality and degenerate cases are harmless. Whether total unrestricted vector-field advances cover the selected source scope cannot be established from the supplied passage; any actual restriction would be reduced applicability, not stronger content."
    },
    {
      "id": "C11",
      "status": "pass",
      "source_evidence": "The selected passage imposes no exceptional-case conditions or undefined operations.",
      "lean_evidence": "Fin.last n always exists; n=0 gives a single-entry history. Empty Cell or m=0 makes the state space a singleton.",
      "reasoning": "All expressions remain defined. At n=0 every advance depends on the only history entry. Singleton-state cases satisfy the characterization consistently."
    },
    {
      "id": "C12",
      "status": "pass",
      "source_evidence": "The source distinguishes one-step temporal dependence as a substantive method property.",
      "lean_evidence": "For a singleton Cell, m=1 and n=1, advance returning the final state satisfies D001; advance returning the initial state fails D001 when equal-final histories have different initial values.",
      "reasoning": "The modeled property has both satisfying and violating examples. The equivalence is not an artifact of impossible hypotheses or exclusively degenerate types."
    },
    {
      "id": "N01",
      "status": "unclear",
      "source_evidence": "The selected sentence concerns the information required for a numerical transition.",
      "lean_evidence": "advance maps a history to a numerical field, and the proposition characterizes removal of dependence on earlier entries.",
      "reasoning": "The correct temporal process is represented, and the source requires no particular numerical formula. Linkage to the full source class remains conditional on the state and admissibility modeling choices."
    },
    {
      "id": "N02",
      "status": "not-applicable",
      "source_evidence": "The selected characterization states no norm, metric, or componentwise bound.",
      "lean_evidence": "The proposition contains only function equality and dependence; no norm or metric occurs.",
      "reasoning": "Vector components index states without introducing any quantitative comparison convention."
    },
    {
      "id": "N03",
      "status": "not-applicable",
      "source_evidence": "No error or stability claim occurs in the selected sentence.",
      "lean_evidence": "There are no error, conditioning, or stability predicates.",
      "reasoning": "The target concerns temporal information dependence alone."
    },
    {
      "id": "N04",
      "status": "pass",
      "source_evidence": "The surrounding paragraph identifies Q as the numerical approximation to q.",
      "lean_evidence": "The state and advance output are modeled numerical fields; no equality to an exact PDE solution is asserted.",
      "reasoning": "Exact equality of update maps expresses determinism of approximate states and does not assert numerical exactness."
    },
    {
      "id": "N05",
      "status": "not-applicable",
      "source_evidence": "The selected passage contains no asymptotic regime, remainder, or limit.",
      "lean_evidence": "No asymptotic or limiting operation appears.",
      "reasoning": "There is no higher-order or limiting content to preserve."
    },
    {
      "id": "N06",
      "status": "unclear",
      "source_evidence": "Determination is stated in prose without a quantified existence-and-uniqueness claim over all states.",
      "lean_evidence": "A total advance is supplied, and the existential step is total on every spatial vector field.",
      "reasoning": "Within this model, step introduces no additional solvability assumption: every state has a constant-history preimage, so factorization constructs its value. What remains unresolved is whether restricting the characterization to supplied total advances matches the source's unspecified admissible domain."
    }
  ],
  "implications": {
    "lean_implies_source": {
      "verdict": "unclear",
      "reasoning": "Within the represented total-history model, factorization immediately gives complete independence from earlier history, so the intended temporal statement follows. The source does not identify all current data with the unrestricted real vector field or limit methods to total advances on arbitrary histories. Consequently the Lean characterization has not been shown to cover the full source scope."
    },
    "source_implies_lean": {
      "verdict": "unclear",
      "reasoning": "If current data means exactly the modeled state and the supplied advance acts on the intended history domain, the source's determination condition yields fiberwise constancy, and the constant-history construction yields the displayed map. The source alone does not settle those identifications or justify imposing the condition on every mathematically possible history rather than admissible executions."
    }
  },
  "classification": "undetermined",
  "accepted": false,
  "requires_adjudication": true,
  "findings": [
    {
      "severity": "major",
      "category": "unresolved-current-data-representation",
      "source_evidence": "Printed page 10 refers to data at the current time level after introducing Q and other numerical quantities, without enumerating the data object.",
      "lean_evidence": "The current-state projection returns only Cell → Fin m → Real, and step receives exactly that field.",
      "impact": "The essential history-independence idea is represented, but equivalence to the source requires resolving whether auxiliary current data are fixed parameters or must be included in the varying state. Fixed parameters can be captured by advance; varying omitted data cannot."
    },
    {
      "severity": "major",
      "category": "unresolved-effective-domain",
      "source_evidence": "The selected characterization supplies no admissible-state or admissible-history domain and no global totality claim.",
      "lean_evidence": "advance is total on every length-n+1 history, and FactorsThrough compares all pairs of such histories.",
      "impact": "The target correctly characterizes total advances on its chosen domain. Adjudication must determine whether that is an acceptable representation of the source or a restriction relative to methods defined only on admissible data. This must not be labeled stronger merely because a restricted model is used."
    },
    {
      "severity": "note",
      "category": "valid-factorization-characterization",
      "source_evidence": "The source requires next-time determination entirely from current-time data and does not require spatial locality, autonomy, or an explicit formula.",
      "lean_evidence": "step receives the entire spatial field, may depend on n and advance, and exists without a computability requirement.",
      "impact": "There is no single-cell locality error, time-independence assumption, or explicit-versus-implicit substitution. The mathematical equivalence inside the chosen model is sound and nonvacuous."
    }
  ],
  "rationale": "Direct inspection of the attached source pages supports the target's central interpretation as independence from earlier history. The supplied definitions make the factorization equivalence mathematically exact, with the correct current index, full spatial field, and per-transition witness. Acceptance remains unresolved because the source leaves current-data contents and admissible domains unspecified, whereas the target chooses unrestricted histories of numerical vector fields and a total advance. Adjudication is requested for those modeling questions and the associated implication directions; no source bytes or rendering hashes were independently recomputed."
}
